truth_contract.periodogram: The panels use eight actual DFT traces regenerated from the frozen complex-Gaussian stream; the ledger uses exact 96-trial means and CVs: N=256 mean 0.931794/CV 0.843520 and N=16384 mean 0.871399/CV 1.061033.
truth_contract.frontier: Every point is an exact frozen study row. M=32 fails resolution, M=4096 fails CV<0.30, M=64/128/2048 at 50% overlap pass both, and the M=512 overlap trio reports CV 0.178210/0.140159/0.126204.
truth_contract.pipeline: The formula uses KaTeX M, binds numbered stages to the same colors, divides by window energy U, and explicitly labels overlap as correlated evidence rather than independent averages.
truth_contract.sequence: All frames use viewBox 0 0 620 330 and fixed sample-row anchors; frame deltas are lag alignment, accumulator, and transform/ensemble distinction.

accessibility.sequence_alt: Four fixed-layout frames align a sample record with lagged copies, average the available products into estimated autocorrelation values, and transform the lag sequence into an estimated spectrum.
accessibility.periodogram_alt: Short and long white-noise periodograms have different frequency detail but retain a similarly broad distribution of power at one fixed frequency.
accessibility.pipeline_alt: Welch estimation windows several segments, squares and normalizes each transform, and averages them; overlapping segments visibly reuse samples and therefore are correlated.
accessibility.key_image_alt: Welch settings form a resolution-variance frontier; only middle settings both separate tones 0.04 cycles per sample apart and keep empirical coefficient of variation below 0.30.
accessibility.redundant_encoding: Solid/dashed lines, direct labels, point shapes, hatching, and check/cross glyphs duplicate every color role.
accessibility.mobile: Live 312px and 360px checks in light and dark: document scrollWidth equals clientWidth; both component grids stack; raw SVG parents scroll internally at 620px; minimum rendered raw-SVG label size is 12px.
